 import configparser
+import sys
+

+    import tomli as tomllib
 
 DEFAULTS = {"timeout": "10"}

+    """
+    out = dict(DEFAULTS)
+    if str(path).endswith(".toml"):
+        with open(path, "rb") as f:
+            out.update(tomllib.load(f).get("fetchit", {}))
